invariants.rationale: The method accesses methods and fields on 'element', so it is expected not to be null on entry.
tmxFile is used as an argument to methods and is expected not to be null.
imageResolver is passed to other methods; it is expected not to be null.
element.getName().equals("tileset") is used, indicating getName() should not return null.
The number of children in an Element should be non-negative by definition.
